Zed repo. Workspace, not single crate — 236 crates, ~1792 rs files, ~1.34M lines.

**Layout**
- `crates/` — 236 member crates, `[workspace] resolver = "2"` root
- `crates/zed` — main bin, wires app together
- `crates/gpui*` — own UI/app framework (GPUI). Platform backends split: `gpui_macos`, `gpui_windows`, `gpui_linux`, `gpui_web`, `gpui_wgpu`. Core primitives: `Entity<T>`, `Context<T>`, `Window`, async via `cx.spawn`/`cx.background_spawn`.

**Main pieces**
- **Editor core**: `editor`, `multi_buffer`, `buffer_diff`, `text`, `rope`, `sum_tree`, `language`, `language_core`, `syntax_theme`
- **Project/workspace**: `project`, `worktree`, `workspace`, `fs`, `remote`/`remote_server` (remote dev)
- **LSP/DAP**: `lsp`, `dap`, `dap_adapters`, `debugger_ui`, `debugger_tools`
- **AI/agent stack**: `agent`, `agent_ui`, `agent_servers`, `acp_thread`, `language_model*`, per-provider crates (`anthropic`, `open_ai`, `google_ai`, `bedrock`, `mistral`, `ollama`, `deepseek`, `x_ai`, `copilot`, `opencode`...), `edit_prediction*` (Zeta)
- **Collab/backend**: `collab` (server), `rpc`, `proto`, `channel`, `call`, `livekit_client`/`livekit_api`
- **Extensions**: `extension`, `extension_host`, `extension_api`, `extension_cli`
- **UI toolkit**: `ui`, `ui_input`, `theme*`, `title_bar`, `settings*`
- **Terminal/vim/git**: `terminal`, `terminal_view`, `vim`, `git`, `git_ui`, `git_hosting_providers`
- **Infra**: `db`, `sqlez`, `settings`, `client`, `http_client*`, `telemetry*`, `zlog` (logging)

Pattern: fine-grained crates, one concern each (e.g. separate crate per LLM provider, per platform backend). CLAUDE.md root rule: no `mod.rs`, prefer flat files, avoid `unwrap()`.
